native_mechanism_note: LOSSY: recipe = concat + 0.4s analog-noise insert (geq random); dissolve does NOT generate noise (visual effect lost); drone sting preserved via overlay.
description: Burst of VHS-style analog noise (static) covers the seam between clip_a and clip_b. Reads as 'reality breaking' or 'signal corrupted'. Digital horror / found-footage aesthetic.

ffmpeg_params.fade_out_start: Set = duration(clip_a) - 0.1. Quick 0.1s audio fade-out on clip_a before static.

audio_recipe: Quick afade out 0.1s on clip_a, then 0.4s of synthesized static (white noise band-passed 300-4000Hz at volume 0.45) overlaid on a silent gap, then afade in 0.1s on clip_b. Optionally layer drone-tension.mp3 underneath for sub-bass.
audio_static_recipe: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "anoisesrc=color=white:sample_rate=44100:amplitude=0.45" -t 0.4 -af "highpass=f=300,lowpass=f=4000" static-noise.mp3 (pre-generate or layer inline)
avoid_for: More than 2x per video — loses impact via repetition
hyperframes_alternative: GSAP + canvas: overlay <canvas> with requestAnimationFrame drawing random pixels, tween opacity 0→1→0 over 0.4s. Audio scheduled separately.
canonical_observations: Not observed as inter-clip transition in 8 canonical refs. Caption-level glitch/flicker is present in 4/8 refs (ref-08, ref-10, ref-11, ref-12) but applies to text overlay only, NOT inter-clip VHS static. ref-13 has 'cuts flooding' at warp moments (60+ cuts in 5s) — that is rapid cut density, not VHS static. No F1 ref shows analog noise burst between clips. Sub-genre-specific (found-footage/VHS/digital-corruption) — not part of horror-choice canonical pattern.
validated_notes: 0/8 F1 canonical inter-clip observations. Sub-genre-specific. Use cap: max 2x per reel. Static frequency band 300-4000Hz avoids tinnitus zone. Requires explicit SPEC justification ('found-footage' or 'reality-glitch beat').
